title: Lotor Sphinx
body:
![https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/54251/380/1581111423-159803326.jpeg|medium|right](https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/54251/380/1581111423-159803326.jpeg)

- "Cast iron chef" who wants to start a food stand on the base.
- Wife died, and his son ran away (so he doesn't know where he is). Son's name is Vernon.
- Most law enforcement don't trust him, but the everyday people do (gives out food in exchange for lodging).
- Believes that something better can always happen the next day - no matter how bad this one was.
- Friends with Tessira Vane, who helps advertise his business to her customers.
- Also close with Ermias the merchant, who helped him get back on his feet after he got out of jail.
- Maris stops by the food stall every morning, and tells Lotor about the good news - he listens closely and just says "maybe next time".

### Motivation and Goals

 - [ ]  Train for proficiency in Tinkers' Tools.
 - 10 weeks and and 100gp per week
 - [x] Find and train 3 staff members (for his food stall) - DC 18 ✅ 2026-04-06
	 - [ ]  **Saza** (Female Tiefling Wizard, Neutral, Friendly). Purple tiefling who became Lotor's first worker (sous chef) after Maris failed to convince her of the merits of Adeus (now 2 steps away from conversion).
	 - [ ]  **Keltar** (NB Dragonborn Bard, Neutral, Indifferent). Head chef, who can breathe fire out of their nose.
	 - [ ]  **Meridra** (Male Kuo-Toa Magewright, Neutral, Friendly). Bus boy who used to work for Chief Gregaarious but was rescued from prison (after being falsely accused of the murder) by Lotor.
 - [ ]  Hunt down and kill creatures for ingredients. For each unique creature found and made into a unique dish, gain one level.
	 - [x] Kelp Drake ✅ 2026-03-30
	 - [ ]  
 - [ ]  Find an Island Turtle and gather ingredients from its back.
 - [ ]  Find his son.
